notes.title: A.I.L.A: Developer Commentary & Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

A.I.L.A is releasing this year and we're hard at work bug fixing and polishing! It's been so much fun working on our second horror game, and really rewarding seeing how far we've come since launching Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel back in 2022. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/62de66ae4edafaca98a1341653d92d33a32cf36b.jpg

Check out our latest dev commentary! 

As some of you might know, MaxMRM is our Creative Director, and he's narrated our dev commentary trailer. This is a deep dive into what to expect from A.I.L.A, and gives a closer look at the story and the game's main character, Samuel. There's also some unseen before gameplay footage, so it's worth watching if you're eager to see more of what we've been creating!

[previewyoutube=e4vjU3yaCgE;full][/previewyoutube]

New screenshots 

We've also taken some new screenshots which we wanted to share. These show some of the different scenarios Samuel encounters. A.I.L.A is a psychological horror game, but you'll find there's definitely elements of survival and threats throughout!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/ec693217d4b0c233b73ed098f0b58209e1346cdf.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/bbd0d7bccdcf1aa7832444b0fd0d88f7072b2ff8.jpg

Ask us anything! 

Do you have any questions about A.I.L.A? Would you like to know more about our development journey or what's coming to the game? Let us know in the comments and we'll work on a Q&A. 

Thanks so much for reading! 

Pulsatrix Studios
